entries.bcecd2dd810eb3b7: The group consists of the company (SANKO METAL INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.), four unconsolidated subsidiaries and one other affiliated company. Its main businesses are the roofing business and the building materials business, and it also sells electricity generated by solar power. The head office is located in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The number of employees of the reporting company is 520 (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥47,058 million.
entries.bff81d5f77160e37: On the sales side, the company focuses on strengthening design-in sales centered on technical proposals, and aims to expand orders by bringing competitive products and construction methods to the market. On the construction side, against a background of a high level of order backlog, it will carry out construction work reliably and work to pass on cost increases in materials, labor, logistics and equipment through prices and to further reduce costs. Over the medium to long term, the company has set out to create a positive cycle built on "industry-leading product, sales and construction capabilities" by establishing a Quality Control Department in April 2026 to improve "construction quality" and "manufacturing quality" and by advancing improvements in on-site productivity. It is also pursuing initiatives under its Medium-Term Management Policy (2024–2026).
